gallery.title: Keyword Flow Ribbons
gallery.description: Eight Sankey bands are filled with dense, semantically focused word clouds scaled to the transition they explain.

file.name: keyword_flows.csv + flow_keywords.csv
file.description: Eight weighted stage transitions and 24 meaningful, weighted keywords keyed to every source-target pair.

bindings.role: Nested Word Cloud text and size

gallery.composition: Nest Word Cloud into every Sankey link mark. The ribbon source and target become inherited filters, so each cloud contains only that transition's vocabulary; its independent X/Y scale expands the words across the band's length and thickness.

editorHelp.introduction: The starter provides one bound Sankey and one bound Word Cloud using the same graph dataset.

steps.title: Explain every ribbon
steps.action: Nest across all links; source and target are inherited as child filters.
steps.result: Every band receives its own 24-keyword semantic cloud, scaled to fill the ribbon while retaining the original flow width and color.
